title: The owner's tenth notes: bigger boards, wall contact as friction, the wedged hull threads on its centre, a three-state seat hand-over, level shapes on the pedestals, the debrief on one screen, the mortar lands, Isao mends walls mid-wave and checks them, solid buildings, and the purple Pimp My Ride pad
context: Owner, 2026-10-03 (first playtest after 84eac116): 1) the boards larger without more fps, 4x if affordable; 2) bumping walls gives jagged staccato movement and loses weight; 3) the tank still gets stuck between two narrow walls where it looks like it should pass, near a chokepoint by an early landing site; 4) Rotor to Quiver: switch off, a high view with the enemies in the distance, then into the Quiver, distinct states; 5) pedestals should show level 1, 2, 3: square, hexagon, circle; 6) the end-of-sector card has too many sections: one screen, sparklines, tighter bonus callouts, the tabs optional, not CONTINUE five times; 7) the mortar round vanishes before it hits the ground; 8) Isao is not reactive enough on wall breaches, and should confirm the last wall closed it; 9) some base structures let the tank through, they should be solid (not the Stålheart, which it drives under); 10) the rover storage as a Pimp My Ride station with a purple circle: stop on it, a modal to change the MÖRK's colours.
outcome: 1) The A6 board is 380 triangles in one draw call, so size costs nothing; room does. The pair now stands at 2.25 (18 m each, 3x the old 6 m) end to end on a 12 x 36 m slab west of the Stålheart facing it; 4x does not fit between HUGIN, the launcher and the radar with the 4 m slab gap test/base-plan.mjs keeps. 2) A head-on wall hit no longer fires the run-over thud (65% drag, camera dip, run-up wiped); the into-wall share bleeds the run-up at TANK_WALL.scrub per second and turns the heading toward the slide at TANK_WALL.align, so the hull scrapes round parallel. 3) Once the stuck watch has run HULL_STUCK.after, the footprint drops its nose and tail checks and the hull threads on its centre; the specific chokepoint was not reproduced. 4) takeControlPose with a previous seat: up and out of the old optic to a high view over the new mount looking down its lane (0-30%), held there (to 62%), then a dive to the mount, landed on the optic by the seat glide; 5.6 s. 5) src/fx/tier-plate.js: a glowing band at each pedestal's foot in the sentry's colour, square, hexagon, circle by level. 6) The debrief's first page is one screen (eight numbers, a chip per breach, the tempo sparkline with the belt ladder, citations as small chips); CONTINUE is on every page, Space/Enter continues, a stray click only lands the numbers, DETAIL and the tabs are optional. 7) Mortar shells burst on proximity to any body mid-arc and their arc ended half a wall up while the burst (since the ninth notes) sat on the ground; a shell now flies to the ground or rock top and bursts only where it lands. 8) A wall cell no body is within BASE_REPAIR.clearCells (3) of is mended mid-wave; after each wall he hovers BASE_REPAIR.check (1.6 s) and calls BREACH SEALED or STILL OPEN · NEXT SEGMENT. 9) story-base solidAt: SOLID_STRUCTURES (not the Stålheart, bays, solar array, Rotor or the two wrecks) stop the hull on a footprint measured once off each model, the meshes that reach its ground; the hull glances off at TANK_WALL.glance angles. 10) src/fx/paint-pad.js: a purple pad beside the bays (east of them, off the roll-out), live with the bays; stopped on it 0.8 s, the paint shop opens over the paused game titled PIMP MY RIDE with every dye extracted so far; it reopens only after the hull leaves.
alternatives: Boards at 4x on the rock rim above the base: room enough, but a print bed on rock and a sightline from the floor were untried
Widening the hull's clearance at chokepoints everywhere: the footprint guards the clipping the owner asked to fix before; the squeeze only applies to a hull already wedged
Solid boxes from island plots instead of model footprints: an island is much larger than what stands on it
evidence: scripts/browser-lock.sh node scripts/browser-test.mjs --round10 (the pad opens the shop and pauses, DONE resumes, no reopen while parked; artifacts/browser/round10-paint-pad.png)

--sectors (artifacts/browser/sectors-debrief.png, the one-screen summary), --colony (artifacts/browser/colony-board.png, the boards at 3x), --round7 (artifacts/browser/round7-quiver-transfer.png, the high view)
test/programme-host.mjs (mid-wave mend when clear, wait when a body is near, BREACH SEALED after the check), test/base-plan.mjs (the board slab clears its neighbours)
Not yet seen: the tier plates in play, the wall friction and squeeze in a real corridor, the mortar's landing, buildings blocking the hull in play
